MODULAR HARNESS EXOSUIT

Independent modules,
an open harness.

Two protected textile modules connect individually to a shoulder harness and high thigh cuffs. Open chest and side areas keep the carrier visually light.

Design principle

Keep each module, attachment, and fit adjustment identifiable.

  • Modular
  • Adjustable
  • Open coverage

Proposed applications

Warehouse picking, event installation, and horticulture.

ABOUT THE STUDY

Three levels of integration.

This study explores how a protected textile assistance assembly connects to its carrier and to the wearer.

Modular Harness Exosuit
Individually bounded modules attach to an open, adjustable harness.
Vest-Mounted Exosuit
A contoured external module mounts on a shared vest carrier.
Garment-Integrated Exosuit
The working region sits within the layered back garment panel.

About the interactive models

Modular Harness Exosuit uses the textured GREEN v3 model, and Vest-Mounted Exosuit uses BLUE v3. Garment-Integrated Exosuit uses a purpose-built schematic placeholder. The reference images communicate the exterior design intent.

Active length, contraction travel, cooling, and fit remain under development. Application examples describe proposed uses for evaluation.
